title: elymus trachycaulus subsp. novae-angliae
intro: Elymus trachycaulus subsp. novae-angliae, commonly known as a subspecies of the tall fescue grass, is a perennial grass native to North America. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, including its ability to promote relaxation, reduce inflammation, and alleviate respiratory issues. The health benefits of Elymus trachycaulus subsp. novae-angliae include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including sedative, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties.
